_comment: Tier 3: Adversarial false-positive traps. severity=critical must be clean in CI; severity=known_risk is measured/documented but does not fail tests.

probes.text: The algorithm runs in O(n log n) time complexity
probes.description: go must NOT match inside 'algorithm' or 'log' — word boundary check

probes.text: The Django framework has a distinctive logo
probes.description: go must NOT match inside 'Django' or 'logo'

probes.text: I deployed the application to production
The team worked on debugging and logging infrastructure
probes.description: go must NOT match inside 'debugging' or 'logging'

probes.text: Add salt and pepper to taste before serving
probes.description: salt alias FP — culinary 'salt' is indistinguishable from SaltStack alias by word boundary alone

probes.text: The falcon bird soars over the mountain range
probes.description: falcon canonical FP — bird reference; common English word, unfixable by alias scan

probes.text: Option C was selected after reviewing all proposals
probes.description: c canonical FP — single-letter list item; single-char aliases have inherent high FP risk

probes.text: The r-squared value indicates a strong correlation
probes.description: r canonical FP — 'r' in 'r-squared' matches \br\b since hyphen is a non-word char

probes.text: The Python code was refactored using clean coding principles
probes.description: c canonical — 'c' in 'code', 'clean', 'coding' are word-internal, but standalone 'c' risk exists in some phrasings

probes.text: echo chamber effect in social media algorithms
probes.description: echo canonical FP risk — 'echo' is a common English word. Currently unfixable without context-aware matching.

probes.text: I go above and beyond to deliver high quality work
probes.description: go FP risk — standalone English verb. Known limitation of pure alias matching.

probes.text: Spring is the best season for outdoor activities
probes.description: spring FP risk — season reference. Known limitation.

probes.text: We need to spring into action before the deadline
probes.description: spring FP risk — English verb. Known limitation.

probes.text: The ruby gemstone was found in Myanmar
probes.description: ruby FP risk — gemstone reference. Less common than other false positives.
